title: Sollamale
desc: Shwetha, a rich and kind woman, assumes that Nadaraj cannot speak and shows empathy towards him. When their friendship blossoms into love, Nadaraj faces an arduous task of confessing the truth.

title: Murattu Singam
desc: An officer is sent on a mission where he must pretend to be a teacher to gather information about a gangster. Things get complicated when he decides to woo his daughter against his lover's wishes.

title: Priya
desc: A leading film actress finds herself controlled by her producer, who prevents her from getting married. She soon seeks the help of a lawyer to free herself from his grip.

title: Jai Hind
desc: After his brother is killed in a terrorist attack, Bharat, a policeman, assures his mother that he will resign. However, when he learns of a secret terrorist organisation he sets out to capture them.

title: Kidaari
desc: Kombaiah Pandian, a village bigwig, falls victim to a brutal stabbing by an enemy. Consequently, his devoted servant Kidari embarks on a mission to unmask the assailant.
